summary: This Form 6-K filed by Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSMC) reports routine monthly updates on insider shareholding changes, pledge changes, asset transactions (fixed-income acquisition of NT$21.7 billion and equity disposition of NT$7.3 billion per board approvals), capital appropriations, bond issuances, and share cancellations for April 2026. The filing serves as a periodic disclosure for a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16 and contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. It is a standard current report with no actionable corporate action.
